## Pricing

- **Pricing:** Flexible, scope-based support for individuals, charities and small businesses
- **Packages:** Flexible, zero-retainer support packages
- **Areas served:** Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Dorset, Hampshire

## Services

- **AI Automation Setup:** Email, enquiry and follow-up automation; CRM, booking, spreadsheet and website workflows; Zapier, Make, API and no-code automation support.
- **Custom AI Agents:** Customer enquiry and FAQ assistants; internal knowledge-base agents; sales, onboarding and admin support agents.
- **One-to-One AI Support:** ChatGPT, Claude and everyday AI workflows; prompting for emails, quotes, content and planning; calm Zoom support for individuals, charities and small organisations.
- **Charity & Community Support:** Neuro-friendly AI consultancy and digital safety support for charities and community organisations.
- **Focus:** Sole traders, small businesses, individuals and charities. AiGENCY is not currently offering large corporate training programmes or office-based presentations.
- **Ongoing AI Support:** Review automations and fix friction; improve prompts and agent behaviour; support staff as habits change.
- **AI Business Audit:** Map admin bottlenecks and repeated tasks; spot safe automation opportunities; prioritise quick wins; plain-English recommendations.

## Credentials

- **Experience:** 25+ years in applied psychology, computing, and design.
- **Education:** Master of Arts in Sound Design for the Moving Image from Bournemouth Media School.
- **Recognition:** Local Bournemouth AI consultancy; verify current search positions independently.

## Community

- **Waste Not Want Not Partnership:** Voluntary technology implementation and digital safety program launching late 2026 in Poole, supporting individuals with learning difficulties.
